summary: 32 units reviewed; 19 need fixes. 10 errors, 33 minor, of which 6 have no patch (MANUAL). Main errors: unit 4 added noun 'sticks'; unit 8 bracketed '(सूर्य)'; unit 18 epithets of tvā wrongly read as separate objects; unit 22 dive-dive is dative; unit 23 verb imported from unit 22. Many Hindi lines carried bracketed glosses (units 4, 8, 10, 13, 16, 21, 23, 27), removed by patches. Unit 7 parse (rocanā f. nom. sg. subject, apānatī agreeing) is kept as the standard reading; only the Hindi attachment of asya and the akhyan note are corrected. No regrouping suggested; the GROUPING note of unit 23 is sensible. Token splits match the printed text. Confidence honest except unit 22 (better medium).
